definitionZh: : 其中() CSS 伪类函数将一个选择器列表作为其参数,并选择该列表中一个选择器可以选择的任何元素.
sourceDefinition: The :where() CSS pseudo-class function takes a selector list as its argument, and selects any element that can be selected by one of the selectors in that list.
